title: Er t6: FFIM tray temperature sensor

source.oemTestTitle: Service mode test 45: FFIM tray temp sensor

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions when applicable.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power cord before servicing this appliance.

steps.title: Harness and pin backouts
steps.body: Check fresh-food ice maker tray temperature sensor harness for pin backouts, pinched or damaged wires before replacing parts. Reseat connector at main control board.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check fresh-food ice maker tray temperature sensor harness for pin backouts, pinched or damaged wires before replacing parts. Reseat connector at main control board.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace harness when damaged or loose.

steps.title: Repair harness
steps.body: Repair wiring or reseat connector, then retest in service mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair wiring or reseat connector, then retest in service mode.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: System Diagnostic Mode entered. Navigate to the sensor test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service mode entry, proceed with OEM sensor readout and resistance checks.

steps.title: Service mode test 45 readout
steps.body: In System Diagnostic Mode, navigate to test 45 (FFIM tray temp sensor). Display should show compartment temperature — not OP (open) or SH (short).
steps.sourceExcerpt: In System Diagnostic Mode, navigate to test 45 (FFIM tray temp sensor). Display should show compartment temperature — not OP (open) or SH (short).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: OP/SH indicates open or shorted sensor circuit.

steps.title: FFIM tray temp sensor resistance
steps.body: Power off. Measure FFIM tray temp sensor NTC at harness — typical 5–16 kΩ at room temperature. Contact TID before main board replacement per service data sheet.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Measure FFIM tray temp sensor NTC at harness — typical 5–16 kΩ at room temperature. Contact TID before main board replacement per service data sheet.

steps.title: Replace sensor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace FFIM tray temp sensor or harness when open, shorted, or out of range.

steps.title: Replace main PCB
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main control board when sensor and harness verified good but Er code persists.

steps.title: Sensor verified
steps.oemOutcome: FFIM tray temp sensor resistance and harness verified.
